reviewFindings.title: Rate limiter storage is single-node only
reviewFindings.detail: Token buckets live in process memory, which is correct for the worked example but would not coordinate across multiple app instances.
reviewFindings.recommendation: Swap the in-memory map for a shared store interface backed by Redis before production deployment.

reviewFindings.title: Refresh-token revocation is not persisted
reviewFindings.detail: The auth flow supports refresh tokens, but it remains stateless and therefore cannot revoke individual refresh sessions.
reviewFindings.recommendation: Introduce a session or token registry if the package moves beyond the current scoped challenge environment.

reviewFindings.title: Validation DSL is intentionally narrower than full JSON Schema
reviewFindings.detail: The validator covers the worked example requirements but does not attempt to implement every JSON Schema feature.
reviewFindings.recommendation: Expand the schema engine or plug in AJV if future specs require nested structures or advanced schema composition.

coverage.note: Coverage is proportional to challenge scope (3 modules). All critical paths tested.
